title: Project Graph Context (v2)
description: Index graph over a project's design documents and registries. Hierarchy: Root -> component -> feature -> function. Decisions and issues attach to components/features/functions. Invariants not expressible in JSON Schema and enforced by the skill (rule R1): every key of `nodes` equals that node's `id`; `current_node` and every edge target exist in `nodes`; no self-edges; `part_of` is acyclic; `resolves` is decision->issue only and its target has issue_status resolved; `supersedes` is decision->decision only; `source_ref` matches a `config.registries[].id_pattern` when registries are defined; non-component `code_targets` fall under some component's `code_targets`.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Ignored by the skill.

current_node.description: The single node being worked on now, or null when no work is active. Must be a key of `nodes`. Written by /graph-hydrate and /graph-handover only.

nodes.description: All graph nodes keyed by node id. Each key must equal the `id` of its value.

nodeId.description: Stable node identifier: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore; must start with a letter or digit.

nodeType.description: component: architectural unit under Root (its code_targets are its root directories). feature / function: design-document structure (function is a split child of a feature). decision / issue: registry entries attached to the structure. plan: what was planned (goal, approval, log); its steps are nodes part_of it. rule: a working rule the user set. task: manual use only; never generated by /graph-init.

wipStatus.description: PLANNED = not yet started (a plan step, D33 / D34 R-b); IN_PROGRESS; BLOCKED; DONE. Not used on issue nodes (they carry issue_status).

issueStatus.description: State of an issue node. open; resolved (by a decision's `resolves` edge or by an action); transferred (handed to another project or session).

id.description: Node identifier. Must equal the key under which this node is stored in `nodes`.

docs.description: Documents describing this node. May be empty.

code_targets.description: Files or directories this node owns. For a component: its root directory(ies). For any other type: each path must fall under some component's code_targets. May be empty.

part_of.description: Parent node (at most one). feature -> component; function -> feature or function; decision/issue -> the component/feature/function it is attached to. Component nodes have no parent. A node that is the target of part_of is an index node.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite or expectation. feature -> feature; feature/function -> function of another component (cross-component expectation); issue -> decision that raised it.

affects.description: Impact. decision -> component/feature/function it constrains; issue -> component/feature/function it impacts.

resolves.description: decision -> issue it resolves. Only on decision nodes; targets must be issue nodes.

supersedes.description: decision -> earlier decision it replaces or refines. Only on decision nodes; targets must be decision nodes.

source_ref.description: Registry id verbatim (e.g. D-022, TBD-24). decision and issue nodes only; single-valued: one node = one registry entry.

folded.description: Registry ids of superseded decisions / resolved issues absorbed into this decision by compaction. Their text remains in the registry file. decision nodes only.

next.description: True on the item(s) to take up next (D33). feature / function / task / issue only. The Backlog view lists every node carrying it.

owner.description: Who resolves the issue. issue nodes only.

trigger.description: When, or on what event, the issue is taken up. issue nodes only.

file.description: The entity file holding this node's text (one file per entity, docs/entities/<id>.md; plan integrity-store P1). decision / issue / plan / rule only. Written by graph_tool only; append-only.

sha256.description: sha256 of `file` as last written by graph_tool; validate reports a file changed outside the tool (P2).

closed_by.description: What closed the issue: a decision registry id, a commit hash, or a short action text. issue nodes only; required when issue_status is not open.

id_pattern.description: Regular expression (ECMA-262 syntax) matching one registry id, e.g. ^D-\d{3}$.

file.description: Project-relative path of the registry file that holds the entries' text.

config.description: Project-wide settings written by the /graph-init Q&A and editable by hand. Deliberately absent: code_roots (derived from component nodes), project_name and version (owned by git / CLAUDE.md).

interaction_language.description: BCP-47 tag (e.g. ja, en). Language for every question, recommendation table, approval request and checklist shown to the user. Stored artifacts stay English.

design_root.description: Directory whose document structure the feature/function layer mirrors, e.g. docs/design/.

docs_scope.description: Glob patterns /graph-init reads to derive nodes. Default: <design_root>/**/*.md.

registries.description: How decision / issue ids are recognised and where their text lives.

views.description: Generated documents people read (plan integrity-store P3): each is rendered from the graph + entity files on every accepted write and checked by validate (drift = hand edit or stale).

backlog_filter.description: Project default for which open issues the Backlog view lists (D33). Absent = all open issues. PLANNED / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED / next nodes are always listed; whatever the filter excludes is printed as a count per component. Command options override it per call.

growth_threshold.description: Number of attached decision + issue nodes at which /graph-handover proposes splitting a feature/function into children. Default 5.

install.description: Written by /graph-install for footprint verification on uninstall.
